decision: Use documented patrician residences and surviving medieval urban structure; do not infer a facade from the listing alone.
Use parcel rhythm, gabled rows, and west/east social distinction as composition evidence.
Use the research-backed combined work/residence Dielenhaus concept; asset-specific dimensions still require evidence.
Preserve planned street hierarchy and social variation.
Later urban road variants may use irregular granite/fieldstone paving; the current dirt kit is only a rural/material anchor.
Anchor harbor storage and Trave-side composition; current cube quay rejected.
Use the museum's 15-25 m length and 5-8 m width range to validate berth/camera scale, not to design a generic ship.
